privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires changing the 'Item Type' from 'Journal Article' to 'Conference Paper' for three specific papers: 'Attention Is All You Need', 'ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks', and 'Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition'. Crucially, 'Mastering the Game of Go with Deep Neural Networks and Tree Search' must remain a 'Journal Article'. All other metadata (authors, titles, dates) must remain unchanged. In Zotero, the Item Type is the first field in the right-side info pane.
